blocks.text: о- — going round, movement around something
«огибания, движения в обход чего-либо» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of о-. Its examples: объехать, оплыть, обойти, обползти.

head: Word

Meaning (Wiktionary)

to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area)

blocks.text: о- — prefix added to verbs of motion: about, around
prefix added to verbs of motion: about, around — обо- + -йти́ (“to go”) → обойти́ (“to go around”)
